subject: MSStats with DIA-NN. DIANNtoMSstatsFormat input file.

messages.author: 3cd3e191849308bb
messages.subject: MSStats with DIA-NN. DIANNtoMSstatsFormat input file.
parts:
Hi there!

I´m just starting to use MSStats with DIA-NN, and I'm wondering what DIA-NN output file I need to use in DIANNtoMSstatsFormat.

Thanks!

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: MSStats with DIA-NN. DIANNtoMSstatsFormat input file.
parts:
Hello,

You need the DIA-NN PSM report. It should be named "diann_report.tsv". Additionally, you will need to create an annotation file that maps the run names in DIA-NN to your experimental design. For more information on this check out the MSstats v4 paper supplementary.


Best,
Devon
